name: Ekipa Noći
description: Ti si Crew Manager Kluboslavija turneje. Za svaki event draftuješ ekipu iz karata — DJ, Host, Sound, Video, Security. Hemija pravi noć. Slaba ekipa = prazna bina.

modules.src/main.js: Bootstrap, state machine, orchestrates all phases
modules.src/config.js: Central constants: tiers, XP thresholds, score brackets, event weights
modules.src/input.js: Click/touch/keyboard handlers for card selection and buttons
modules.src/render.js: DOM card rendering, fan layout, animations
modules.src/ui.js: HUD updates, phase header, budget/rep display
modules.src/share.js: Tour card screenshot + Web Share API
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio: lobby beat, card whoosh, stingers
modules.src/entities/card.js: Card class (from data, ability evaluation, loyalty modifier)
modules.src/systems/deck.js: Draft pool: draw 3 random per role, exclude burned/unavailable
modules.src/systems/budget.js: Tier filtering by budget, deduction on card pick
modules.src/systems/crew.js: Crew retention: who stays, who leaves, loyalty tracking
modules.src/systems/progression.js: Rep XP update, unlock triggers, event advance
modules.src/systems/tour.js: Tour Score weighted sum + loyalty + consistency bonuses
modules.src/systems/grand_finale.js: Seeded random preferred tags for Event 5
modules.src/content/synergy_data.js: 12 synergy pairs with effects and flavor
modules.src/content/events_data.js: 5 events with preferred tags, budgets, difficulty mods
modules.src/ui/phase_display.js: Draft phase UI: role tabs, hand of 3 cards
modules.src/ui/event_result.js: Event result screen: score breakdown, crew changes
modules.src/ui/tour_end.js: Final Tour Score display + share trigger
modules.styles/ui.css: HUD, buttons, modals, card element styles
modules.styles/game.css: Animations: card flip, slide, stinger effects
modules.styles/theme.css: Kluboslavija palette: dark navy/black + neon purple/teal
